P.name: Short Fuse
P.title: Template:Data Ziggs/Short Fuse
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Short Fuse|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Ziggs
|skill        = I
|icon         = Short Fuse.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, {{cis|Ziggs}} next basic attack will deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, increased against {{tip|structures}}.
|blurb2      = ''Short Fuse's'' cooldown is {{sti|cdr|reduced}} whenever '''Ziggs''' casts an ability.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Ziggs''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to deal {{as|{{pp|16+4*x for 6; then +8*x for 6; then +12*x for 8|formula = 16 + 4 per level up to 6, then + 8 per level up to 12, then + 12 per level up to 18}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}},{{ft|increased by 75% against {{tip|structures}}.|increased to {{as|{{pp|1.75*(20+4*(x-1)) for 6;then +1.75*8*x for 6;then +1.75*12*x for 8|formula={{ap|20*1.75}} + {{ap|4*1.75}} per level up to 6, then + {{ap|8*1.75}} per level up to level 12, then + {{ap|12*1.75}} per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*1.75}}% AP)}} against {{tip|structures}}.}}
|description2 = ''Short Fuse's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{pp|4 to 6 for 3|1 to 13}} seconds whenever '''Ziggs''' casts an {{tip|ability}}.
|static       = {{tt|12|Cooldown starts on-attack}}
|speed        = {{tt|1500|Attack missile speed, same as basic attacks}}
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = magic
|spelleffects = Proc
|spellshield  = False
|parry = unknown
|notes        = 
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|wards}}.
* The cooldown reduction is granted at the start of the abilities' cast time.
* ''Short Fuse'' will go on cooldown but not deal any damage if the attack misses due to {{tip|blind}}.
* {{Pending for test}}: ''Short Fuse's'' interactions with {{tip|dodge|dodging}} and {{tip|block|blocking}} effects.
}}

W.name: Satchel Charge
W.title: Template:Data Ziggs/Satchel Charge
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Satchel Charge|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Ziggs
|skill        = W
|icon         = Satchel Charge.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ziggs}} hurls a charge to the target location that remains for a few seconds. ''Satchel Charge'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Recast:}} The charge explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knock back}} nearby enemies hit. If this hits '''Ziggs''', he will {{tip|dash}} farther away.
|blurb3      = The explosion will {{tip|execute}} {{tip|turrets}} hit {{as|below a certain health}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' hurls a charge to the target location, remaining there for 4 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area. ''Satchel Charge'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. If recast while in flight, the charge will explode immediately upon landing.
|description2 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Ziggs''' detonates the charge, causing it to explode to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} over {{fd|0.5}} seconds up to 500 units away from the center of the explosion, though not through terrain. If this hits '''Ziggs''', he will {{tip|dash}} up to 825 units away from the center.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
|description3 = {{cci|Satchel Charge Turret Explosion Indicator.png|border=false||{{sbc|Turret Explosion:}}}} The explosion also {{ccs|{{tip|execute|executes}}|magic}} enemy {{tip|turrets}} within that are below a {{as|'''maximum''' health}} threshold.
|leveling3    = {{st|Demolition Threshold|{{as|{{ap|25 to 35}}% of turret's '''maximum''' health}}}}
|description4 = '''''Ziggs''' will not {{tip|dash}} from the explosion if he is {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''
|target range = 1000
|speed        = {{tt|1750|Missile speed}} <!--/ {{tt|X|Knockback speed}} / {{tt|Y|Dash speed}}-->
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|325|Satchel explosion radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly = true}}{{tt|400|Satchel sight radius}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|20 to 12}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = 80
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = [[Location-targeted|Location]] / [[Auto-targeted|Auto]]
|affects      = Enemies / Self
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|damagetype   = magic
|projectile   = true
|spelleffects = special
|onhiteffects = 
|grounded = special
|knockdown = true
|spellshield  = True
|outofrange   = Walk in range of the target location to cast (first cast)
|notes        = 
*The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
**Detonating the ability manually does not.
* Deals {{tip|area damage}} to non-turrets and {{tip|raw damage}} to turrets.
* ''Satchel Charge's'' distance increases with proximity to the charge, resulting in being knocked straight up when aligned directly on top of it.
* '''Ziggs''' will not ''dash'' from ''Satchel Charge's'' detonation while {{si|Teleport|Teleporting}} but he will while {{si|Recall|Recalling}}.
}}

E.name: Hexplosive Minefield
E.title: Template:Data Ziggs/Hexplosive Minefield
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Hexplosive Minefield|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Ziggs
|skill        = E
|icon         = Hexplosive Minefield.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ziggs}} scatters proximity mines over the target location that remain a period. Each mine will explode upon contact with an enemy or terrain, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|slow|slowing}} them.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' scatters a cluster of 11 proximity mines over the target location that grant {{tip|sight}} of the area for 2 seconds, {{tt|arming after {{fd|0.5}} seconds|travel time of the mines spreading out plus a brief delay}} and lasting for up to 10 seconds.
|description2 = Each mine within the area explodes upon contact with terrain or an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around the explosion for 2 seconds. An enemy takes 40% damage from subsequent mines.
|leveling2     = {{st|Magic Damage per Mine|{{ap|30 to 190}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25 to 45}}% AP)}}|Reduced Damage per Mine|{{ap|30*0.4 to 190*0.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*0.4 to 45*0.4}}% AP)}}|Maximum Total Magic Damage|{{ap|30*(1+0.4*10) to 190*(1+0.4*10)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*(1+0.4*10) to 45*(1+0.4*10)}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|10 to 50}}%}}
|target range = 900
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|335|Effective minefield radius}}|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|135|Detection and explosion radius of each individual mine}}}}
|speed        = {{tt|1550|Travel speed to cast location}}
|cooldown     = 16
|cost         = {{ap|70 to 110}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|costtype     = mana
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = magic
|projectile   = true
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|onhiteffects = 
|spellshield  = Special
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* The mine cluster is built of 2 rings, with 3 mines in the inner ring (radius pending for test) and 8 mines on the other ring (200 radius), all equally spaced.
** The angular offset is randomized on each cast.
** Because of the {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 135 detonation radius of each mine, the total possible range of a mine from the minefield hitting an enemy from the cast location is {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 335 units. It will often be slightly less as the minefield is not guaranteed to be angled the right way for this.
* Mines will not explode upon contact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the effects of a single detonation.
}}

R.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
R.title: Template:Data Ziggs/Mega Inferno Bomb
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Mega Inferno Bomb|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Ziggs
|skill        = R

|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ziggs}} catapults the ''Mega Inferno Bomb'' to the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, increased at the epicenter.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' catapults the ''Mega Inferno Bomb'' to the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 4 seconds.
|icon2        = Mega Inferno Bomb Minimap.png
|description2 = The bomb explodes upon arrival to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 65% against those outside of the epicenter.
|leveling2    = {{st|Epicenter Magic Damage|{{ap|300 to 700|round=2}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|300*0.65 to 700*0.65}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*0.65}}% AP)}}}}
|speed        = 2250
|target range = 5000
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|525|Explosion radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|600|Area reveal radius}}}}
|inner radius = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 250
|cooldown     = {{ap|120 to 70}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.375}}
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|projectile   = false
|damagetype   = magic
|spelleffects = aoe
|onhiteffects = 
|spellshield  = True
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* Allies cannot see ''Mega Inferno Bomb's'' area indicator until shortly before the blast.
* ''Mega Inferno Bomb'' takes {{fd|2.64}} seconds from the start of the cast time to land when cast at maximum range (reduced to {{fd|1.617}} seconds from the start of the cast time when casting within {{tt|2700|Estimated}} units).
** When cast within 2700 units, ''Mega Inferno Bomb'' has a fixed travel time. Beyond that, the travel time is equal to the cast distance divided by the now-fixed missile speed.
* The area reveal on the target location begins as soon as the cast time is completed and can see into {{tip|brush}} and across terrain.
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Ziggs_Original_R_2.ogg}} ''"I bring the Big One!"''
